format: NDCA Sanctioned events: Chairman of Adjudicators

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: At least one qualified Chairman must officiate; the Chairman must be a U.S. resident, on the current roster, with full membership in all categories of the event, plus a Scrutineering Certificate for a Championship; levels CH1-CH3 limit which events they may chair (CH1 and CH2 also need an active S1 Scrutineer License). A Scrutineer may not serve as Chairman at the same event. The Chairman should be non-voting if possible (recommended). A Scrutineer may not serve as Chairman.

requirement: DanceFlow requirement implementing the body rule: body role assignable only with a verified, unexpired credential set; never the generic chair or a manager. A person holding both credentials is not blocked, only from both roles in one event.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6B): attestation record and credential records, surfaced through _compoc_blockers_qualifications. Not built.
interpretation_notes: No roster, membership or certificate data exists (audit J-05/J-06). The non-voting preference is recommended wording and belongs to OD-16. Design only (PR-A, section 6B): no credential model, no attestation table, no test; no compliance claimed. Organizer attestation never clears this requirement and is never shown as governing-body certification. Source tension: III.B.1.f lets a back-up Scrutineer be the chairman. III.B.4 cross-refers substitution to III.B.5 (WDC non-resident rule), which looks mis-numbered; not copied as fact.
decision_refs: OD-15 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now, Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
